segments.text:
No stroke of Calamity upon the people of
God, can separate them from Christ, Rom. 8. 35.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall
TribulatJon? There was a time when Job could
call nothing in this world but trouble his own:
he could not say, my Estate, my Honour, my
Health, my Children; for all these were gone;
yet then he could say, my Redeemer, Job 19. 25.
Well then, there is no cause to sink whilst Interest
in Christ remains sure to us.
